name: Hoshinaga Shiki
source:
The protagonist's classmate. A serious, kind, and studious top student.

While she seems like the type everyone would naturally like, she actually has a very passive personality and is extremely shy around new people.

Because of this, she tends to be a rather inconspicuous presence in class. 

Seeing the always lively protagonist,  she also feel a sense of admiration, thinking “I want to be like that.”

[From [url=http://www.ole-m.net/products/ironmaiden/chara.html]official site[/url]]
